title: Extreme 60-Second Challenge at Seafood Buffet | Unsponsored 1VERSE PILOT Ep. (Qoo Qoo 상봉점)
description:
Welcome to 1VERSE's new series - Unsponsored 1VERSE! Pilot episode taking place at QooQoo, Korea’s all you can eat seafood buffet. No one asked for it, but we're doing it anyways. We begged our favorite restaurant, QooQoo, to film a 60-second commercial for them through completing insane challenges. Do you think we can pull it off, or will it be a total disaster? Watch more to see the chaos unfold. 

Don't forget to like & subscribe, and let us know if you want more of Unsponsored 1VERSE! Comment which brands we should make an unsponsored ad for next ⬇️⬇️⬇️
